en.title: Elite Sports Boxing Gym Duffle Bag for MMA, BJJ, Jiu Jitsu gear,Duffel Athletic Gym Boxing Bag
bullets: Convenient Storage: Elite Sports gym duffel bag for boxing, MMA, BJJ gear is big enough to keep your gym gear and equipment and more conveniently. The gym bag shoes compartment is dedicated to shoes; other dedicated pockets are also available

Mesh Ventilation Compartment: Our boxing gym bag has a mesh pocket and water-resistant lining allowing ventilation drying damp gear preventing this BJJ bag from bad odor. This MMA bag is washable so you can thoroughly wash it

Takes Haymakers with Ease: Our MMA gym backpack duffel is made of heavy-duty Cordura fabric which is known for its strength, durability, and resistance so you won’t be needing to replace this gym bag boxing backpack it anytime soon

For all Occasions: Our sport duffel bags have shoulder straps that transform BJJ gear bag into a backpack making this athletic bag all in one backpack for the gym. Perfect as MMA gear bag, MMA duffle bag, BJJ gym bag, as well as for sports

Dedicated Pockets: The duffel gym bag acts as carryon luggage with a vast array of pockets making this duffel gym bag perfect for dedicated storage. Our sport duffel bags have stowable double carry straps that help you easily carry the MMA gear bag
